title.narrative: Inclusive public policies for Brazil's social transformation

description.narrative: The workplan will connect key features of the Management of Social Transformation (MOST) programme to the current needs of Brazil with a focus on poverty reduction, social inclusion, gender equality, governance, and sustainable development. The element shall support research projects, organize conferences and workshops, and facilitate knowledge sharing among researchers and policymakers, with a focus on strengthening the SHS network of Chairs in the country.
